name: print-social-novavista-yellow-post-with-violet-block-steps
title: Novavista yellow post with violet headline, plus-sign grid and stepped violet blocks
whatItIs: A square yellow post with a faint grid of plus signs, violet headline 'Where Creativity Meets Results, We Are Your Marketing Partner.', and a bottom-right stack of violet and lilac rectangles like steps.
whatItMeans: Cheerful and structured; the plus grid and blocks suggest building results piece by piece.
techniques: Use a plus-sign grid as subtle texture.
Stack rectangles in two tints as a corner motif.
Set a single-colour headline on a bright field.

vocabulary.definition: A repeated pattern of small plus marks.
A lighter version of a colour.
